description: This file defines the class 'Image_Graph_Legend' which manages the display of a legend for plot areas in a graph, including layout, alignment, and rendering logic.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Legend
classes.description: A class for displaying and managing a legend in a graph, including layout, alignment, and rendering.

methods.name: Image_Graph_Legend
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the legend object and sets default padding.

methods.name: _plotCount
methods.description: Calculates the number of plot elements within the associated plot areas.

methods.name: _parameterArray
methods.description: Generates a default parameter array for legend sample rendering, optionally for simulation.

methods.name: _height
methods.description: Calculates the height of the legend element on the canvas.

methods.name: _width
methods.description: Calculates the width of the legend element on the canvas.

methods.name: setAlignment
methods.description: Sets the alignment of the legend within its parent plot area.

methods.name: _updateCoords
methods.description: Updates the position coordinates of the legend based on alignment and parent plot area.

methods.name: setPlotarea
methods.description: Associates a plot area with the legend for which it displays the legend.

methods.name: _setParent
methods.description: Sets the parent object of the legend, typically the main graph object.

methods.name: setShowMarker
methods.description: Configures whether markers should be shown in the legend.

methods.name: _done
methods.description: Renders the legend on the canvas, including background, plot samples, and positioning.
